AppsFlyer OpenDSR Requests API

Use the OpenDSR Requests API as described in this section to implement DSR compliance. 

- **OpenDSR Request**: Perform one of the above request types: access, portability, erasure, rectification.
- **Status Request**: Query the current status of an OpenDSR request.
- **Discovery Request**: Inquire as to the supported API version and Data Format.
- **Cancellation**: Cancel an OpenDSR request during its pending phase
